title: Grammar card
description: Declarative per-tuning KB record. Stores authorial intent + raw pitch data only; everything computable (home chord, drone map, barre rule, bass, shape function) is DERIVED, never stored. Also the future community-contribution format.

strings.description: Open-string target pitches as MIDI integers, ordered string 1 -> string N (string 1 = thinnest/highest in standard). ARRAY INDEX CARRIES NO PITCH-ORDER MEANING: re-entrant tunings are allowed (non-monotonic) and bass is always computed from the lowest pitch, never from index.

tonic.description: Pitch class (0=C..11=B) of the tuning's key center / drone root. The one authorial anchor; everything else derives. The home chord (open-string sonority) is DERIVED from strings + tonic, not stored.

movableShapes.description: Hand-authored for V1 (R3 derivation deferred). The future R3 algorithm emits into this same structure.

capoBehavior.description: Optional pedagogical prose about how this tuning responds to a capo. NOT structural: a capo is a runtime per-string shift vector, never stored card state.

idiomaticProgressions.description: Optional curated 'the classic move in this tuning is...' pedagogy. The only tuning-specific naming-adjacent data stored on a card.

references.description: Optional representative artists/songs (informational, not reproduced) for the affective layer.

overrides.description: RESERVED SEAM, ships empty in V1. A card MAY later shadow a global rule's Tier-1 relational PHRASING only -- never the computed pitch facts or the absolute (T2/T3) identity. See ADR 0002.

kind.description: definitional=authored tuning fact; theory=universal rule; derived=checkable by computing pitches; editorial=aesthetic/taste (must be hedged when spoken).

verifiedBy.description: How the claim was verified. REQUIRED for kind definitional|derived.

strings.description: Per-string template, ordered string 1 -> string N (same indexing as the card's `strings`).

offset.description: Required when play=fret. Semitone offset relative to the shape's anchor (barre) fret; the shape slides as a rigid block. `open` = absolute fret 0 (a drone, does not slide).

quality.description: The INVARIANT the shape generates (e.g. 'major triad on the upper five strings'). A checkable claim -> provenance.kind must be 'derived' and verified by computing the pitches.

slideExamples.description: Optional pedagogy. The function is DERIVED from anchor vs tonic, not authoritative.
